program_name: Scienze della terra per la gestione dei rischi e dell'ambiente — "Geosciences for Environmental Sustainability" curriculum (Curriculum 2)
teaching_language: PARTIAL / CONTRADICTORY — UNIPG's official presentation states this curriculum is "svolto interamente in lingua inglese" / "tenuto completamente in lingua inglese" (i.e. claims 100% English), but the actual 2026/27 study plan shows 13 INGLESE / 3 ITALIANO modules for this curriculum specifically. Treat as MOSTLY English, not fully English — flag the marketing/study-plan contradiction explicitly rather than trusting the presentation text at face value. The other curriculum of the same degree, Curriculum 1 (Geologia Applicata alla Salvaguardia e alla Pianificazione del Territorio), is Italian-taught.
places_available: Not published for this curriculum specifically.
academic_requirements: General Scienze della terra LM-74 admission requirements apply (Italian laurea triennale in a geology/earth-science-related class or equivalent CFU distribution, assessed by the department); the Geosciences for Environmental Sustainability curriculum choice is made at enrolment. Full CFU breakdown not retrieved in this pass — recommend a dedicated check of the Regolamento didattico (may parallel the sister programme Geology for Energy Resources, M0415, in the same department).
language_requirements: Official quote (only applies if choosing this curriculum): "Se il percorso formativo scelto dallo Studente è svolto interamente in inglese (Curriculum 2), è necessaria la conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno di Livello B2." B2 required. Students may be EXEMPTED from a certificate if they had at least 1 year of English-medium high school, an English-medium high-school diploma, or an English-medium bachelor's degree.
english_certificates_accepted: (exemption) >=1 year of English-medium secondary schooling, English-medium diploma, or English-medium bachelor's degree
entry_exam_or_test: Not confirmed in this pass — likely curriculum/CV review with possible interview, similar to the sister programme Geology for Energy Resources in the same department. Needs dedicated verification.
nulla_osta_required: Not confirmed in this pass — recommend checking UNIPG's online nulla-osta list.
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: UNCONFIRMED — the deadline table explicitly names 'Geology for Energy Resources' (M0415) under PICA call 2026-visa-02 (until 30 Sept 2026, still open) alongside Civil Engineering, but this is a DIFFERENT programme (M0414, 'Scienze della terra per la gestione dei rischi e dell'ambiente') with a similar name — it is not confirmed whether M0414 is grouped with M0415 or falls under the general window (2026-visa-03, closed 7 June 2026). Needs a dedicated check before publishing a deadline; do not assume the two Earth-science programmes share a PICA group just because they are both run by Dipartimento di Fisica e Geologia.
tuition_range: EUR 150-2,200/year via a 17-band ISEE table. Non-EU/foreign-income students use a fixed Flat Tax by home-country UNDP Human Development bracket (Turkey = HIGH HD = EUR 800/year + EUR 16 stamp) or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug-20 Oct 2026 (late to 1 Mar 2027; missing 28 Feb defaults to the maximum band, ~EUR 2,096).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: Not found for this curriculum in this research pass.

Se il percorso formativo scelto dallo Studente è svolto interamente in inglese (Curriculum 2), è necessaria la conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno di Livello B2

uncertainty_notes: The programme's own presentation text claims 100% English delivery ('interamente', 'completamente') but the actual study plan shows 13 EN / 3 IT modules for this curriculum — a confirmed contradiction, flag prominently before publishing as 'fully English'. PICA deadline group is unconfirmed and must not be assumed identical to the similarly-named Geology for Energy Resources (M0415) programme. Academic requirements, entry-exam process, places available, and nulla-osta status were not retrieved and need dedicated follow-up. Data collected 2026-09-05, all sources unipg.it/*.unipg.it only.
